target: W05 / P5 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001: join-type evaluation (ALL_REQUIRED, ANY_ONE, QUORUM, ORDERED, OPTIONAL_SIBLING, CONDITIONAL) over per-workstream results, partial-block semantics (an affected child blocks, unaffected siblings stay valid, never a false global failure), and an AggregateReturnEnvelope builder that is referential, compact and non-authoritative. Base is the frozen, A1-audited W01 head 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875.
invariants: MACRO I03, I14, I16, I18 and sections 17/18 apply. The evaluator never transfers authority between workstreams; a blocked child can never be made green by a sibling's PASS.

Inputs are plain dicts: workstream results {workstream_id, status (enums workstream_status), subject_sha|'NONE', return_ref {path,sha256}} and join declarations {join_id, join_type, requires[], condition, quorum?}. Output join_results and the envelope validate against schemas/governed_execution/aggregate_return_envelope.v1.schema.json (registry from schemas/governed_execution/*.schema.json, read-only).

Join semantics, fixed: ALL_REQUIRED satisfied iff every required id is PASS; ANY_ONE iff at least one PASS; QUORUM iff count(PASS) >= quorum (quorum required, >=1, <= len(requires)); ORDERED iff every required id is PASS and, for consecutive pairs, the earlier one's status is PASS before the later is evaluated (a non-PASS earlier id makes every later id 'not evaluated', reported in affected_workstreams); OPTIONAL_SIBLING satisfied iff the non-optional members are PASS regardless of optional members' status (optional members named by condition string 'optional:<id>,<id>'); CONDITIONAL satisfied iff the condition predicate over statuses (a tiny grammar: '<id>==<status>' joined by ' and ' / ' or ', no nesting) is True. UNKNOWN status in any required member yields satisfied False with the member listed in affected_workstreams; it never counts as PASS.
affected_workstreams = members whose status is not PASS (plus ORDERED not-evaluated members); unaffected_workstreams = members with status PASS. Both sorted.

macro_status derivation is fixed and closed: all declared joins satisfied and every workstream PASS -> PASS_IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRAM_COMPLETE; any workstream BLOCKED or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR or UNKNOWN with at least one other workstream PASS -> PARTIAL_BLOCKED; every workstream non-PASS -> BLOCKED; a caller-supplied global stop condition name from the macro_status enum overrides to that value. No other values are produced.

Named behavioural fixture (MACRO W05): results W01=PASS, W02=BLOCKED, W03=PASS, W04=PASS with joins J_A=ALL_REQUIRED over [W01], J_PARALLEL=ALL_REQUIRED over [W02,W03,W04] yields exactly: join_results [{join_id:'J_A', join_type:'ALL_REQUIRED', satisfied:true, affected_workstreams:[], unaffected_workstreams:['W01']}, {join_id:'J_PARALLEL', join_type:'ALL_REQUIRED', satisfied:false, affected_workstreams:['W02'], unaffected_workstreams:['W03','W04']}], macro_status 'PARTIAL_BLOCKED', next_legal_action 'RESOLVE_W02' (format 'RESOLVE_<first affected id in sorted order>' when PARTIAL_BLOCKED). This is asserted as literals in test.

Envelope builder output: schema_version const, macro_id, macro_status, workstreams (as input, sorted by id), join_results, model_calls (caller-supplied ints, total must equal the sum, else ValueError), mcp (caller-supplied), github_mutations, drift_classifications, blockers, unknowns, residual_risks, operator_gates_used, operator_gates_needed, merge_authorized False, activation_authorized False, next_legal_action, authority 'NONE', is_canonical_truth False. No evidence bytes are copied; only refs.
Base commit exactly 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 in worktree .worktrees/gec-v2-w05 branch feat/gec-v2-w05-macro-join-001. Any other base is STOP_WRONG_BASE.

Write surface is exactly commit.allowlist. Forbidden: src/dopemux/governed_execution/__init__.py, tests/unit/governed_execution/__init__.py, sibling prefixes (dispatch/, environment/, receipts/, freeze/), schemas/**, .control-tower/**, pyproject.toml, tests/governance/governed_execution/**.

Pure: no filesystem writes, no subprocess, no clock, no network. No model audits; no push; no TO/ConPort/dope-memory/GitHub mutation; no placeholders; ASCII only; ruff clean; frozen dataclasses; type hints; one substantive attempt.

pr.body:
## Summary
- W05 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- six join types evaluated over workstream results; partial-block semantics (W01 PASS / W02 BLOCKED / W03 PASS != macro FAIL) asserted as literals
- AggregateReturnEnvelope builder validating against aggregate_return_envelope.v1; referential, authority NONE, is_canonical_truth false

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

requirements: Worktree /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/.worktrees/gec-v2-w05, branch feat/gec-v2-w05-macro-join-001, 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 ancestor of HEAD, clean tree except this packet; tests/governance/governed_execution passes (91).

Frozen dataclasses WorkstreamResult, JoinDecl, JoinResult mirroring the schema field names exactly; JoinType values loaded from or asserted equal to enums.v1 join_type; evaluate_join(decl, results_by_id) -> JoinResult per the fixed semantics; evaluate_all(decls, results) -> tuple[JoinResult,...] in declaration order; derive_macro_status(results, join_results, global_stop: str|None) -> str per the closed derivation; next_legal_action(results, macro_status) -> str.
The CONDITIONAL grammar parser rejects nesting, parentheses and unknown ids with ConditionError; it never evals Python.

build_envelope(macro_id, results, join_results, macro_status, model_calls, mcp, github_mutations, drift_classifications, blockers, unknowns, residual_risks, operator_gates_used, operator_gates_needed, next_legal_action) -> dict; validate against aggregate_return_envelope.v1 via a Registry from schemas/governed_execution/; raise EnvelopeInvalid with sorted errors on failure; ValueError if model_calls.total != sum of the three parts.

test_join_types: for each of the six join types, at least one satisfied and two unsatisfied cases including an UNKNOWN member; QUORUM boundary (== and < quorum); ORDERED early failure marks later members not evaluated; CONDITIONAL grammar acceptance and ConditionError cases.

test_partial_block: the named behavioural fixture asserted as exact literals from the packet invariants (join_results, macro_status PARTIAL_BLOCKED, next_legal_action RESOLVE_W02); all-PASS -> PASS_IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRAM_COMPLETE; all non-PASS -> BLOCKED; global stop override; a PASS sibling never changes a BLOCKED member's status (authority non-transfer, assert input results are unmodified).

test_envelope: built envelope validates; merge_authorized/activation_authorized False, authority NONE, is_canonical_truth False regardless of input; total mismatch raises; no input bytes are copied (envelope contains only refs; assert no key named 'content' or 'payload' anywhere).
